notes.title: Default graphics bug
notes.content: [p]Version 0.9.3 - previously when player launches the game for the first time and not interacting with graphics in settings menu (default value "high"). Game would not detect which option was selected and would automatically turn on "very low" graphics. Now this will not happen and the game will always have "high" graphics as default.[/p]

notes.title: Radio Tower path bug
notes.content: [p]Version 0.9.2 fixed the bug with radio tower path not teleporting the player properly. Now it's fixed but instead of walking in you need to right click it. Sorry for all of the troubles that it caused.[/p]
